description: The full underwriting-inputs bundle a LoanBroker needs for an XLS-66 decision, in one call: cross-broker exposure, XRPLScore + grade, OFAC SDN screening (with its own verifiable receipt), observation history + gaps, and one Merkle-anchored attestation over the whole bundle. FACTS ONLY — it never returns a recommended principal, rate, approve/decline, or probability of default; the broker decides. This is a PAID x402 call: $0.05 USDC on Base at GET /api/x402/lending/underwrite?borrower=r... (no free tier, no API key). For the free components use get_lending_exposure and screen_address_ofac. This tool returns the payment resource details. Params: borrower (r..., required).

borrower.description: XRPL classic address (r...) of the borrower

name: get_underwriting_inputs
